summary:
This brief reads the fact layer generated at 2026-11-10T11:37:15Z, which is 06:37 ET and about 3 hours before the 09:30 ET open, so it is a genuine pre-market snapshot: 19 of the 22 sector and theme rows carry the settled 2026-11-09 US close, the China A-share block carries the settled 2026-11-10 close (all 11 last bars are dated 2026-11-10 and recompute to the published change from the prior close), and the memory, consumer_electronics and robotics rows have already stepped into the 2026-11-10 Asia session. Total risk 68.58 stays high_risk, while the regime flips from risk_off, held for 3 consecutive sessions, to late_cycle, with the score up 1.7 day over day.

The 2026-11-09 US session was a breadth-led advance: all 22 sector and theme rows rose, with a mean of 4.6989 and a median of 4.6906, led by semiconductor equipment 9.7228, networking 9.3246 and the semiconductor ETF proxy 7.4929, with fintech the laggard at 1.0509. 4 of the 5 tracked US names gained and the sole decliner was again NVDA, down 4.2703 to 178.669998, while AMD rose 13.2594, AVGO 8.7814 and MU 6.2536 absorbed the flow. The China A-share block closed 2026-11-10 with all 11 names higher, a mean of 2.7562 and a median of 2.8126, 300223.SZ strongest at 3.8458 and 688825.SH weakest at 1.1503. The Asia session carried that advance: 000660.KS gained 6.6901 and 005930.KS 4.7393, 6861.T 5.0573, 1810.HK 1.6611 and 2317.TW 1.046.

The 1.7 gain comes almost entirely from cross-asset confirmation returning to 62.5 from 50.0, 5 of 8 legs triggered, worth 1.875 points, against 0.166 points given back by equity structure: gold turning from up 1.8307 to down 0.8069 switched gold up off, while bitcoin on 24 hours turning from up 0.72866 to down 0.53948 and copper from up 2.6455 to down 0.4187 switched two risk legs on. The regime therefore moved from risk_off to late_cycle: VIX 25.64 is below 28 and breadth 0.3548 is above 0.35, so both risk_off limbs failed at once, while cross-asset 0.625 at or above 0.55 and VIX 25.64 at or above 18 hit late_cycle. It is the first time breadth has cleared that gate since it moved from 0.3419 to 0.3548, or 55 of 155 names.

Yet 68.58 is still pinned in the middle of high_risk by the level-based dimensions: liquidity and credit 76.77 (high-yield OAS 3.42 at the 87.63 percentile, investment grade 0.93, reverse repo 0.252 scoring 95.02 on risk), macro 73.74 (real rate 2.63 at the 97.67 percentile, 10-year 4.86 at the 92.78 percentile, dollar index 121.8803) and volatility 71.8. The vintages must be stated: rates, credit, FX and VIX stop at 2026-11-06, reverse repo and 5-year inflation expectations are 2026-11-09, the Fed balance sheet is 2026-11-04 and CPI is 2026-09; commodities are intraday quotes and crypto is a 24 hour window, neither a settled close. The 13:30Z CPI tonight is the nearest test, but Chinese relay reports say the BLS will not publish the prior-month CPI year-over-year figure; if that holds, the event carries materially less information than usual.

The news flow is concentrated in Nvidia governance: an independent board investigation, a shareholder class action and Wells Fargo cutting its target to 300 from 315, with money rotating into AMD and AVGO; Nvidia was up more than 2% in the US overnight session this afternoon Beijing time, per second-hand relay. On the Fed side, Governor Waller backs a 25 basis point hike at the December meeting, and 50 basis points if needed, and the FedWatch implied rate of 4.05 still points to tightening. CLS and Wall Street CN items are RSSHub relays (trust: relay) and are used as second-hand aggregation only.

top_risk_drivers.claim: Liquidity and credit at 76.77 is the first level-based dimension holding the total in the middle of high_risk: high-yield OAS 3.42 sits at the 87.63 percentile with investment grade OAS at 0.93 and the 0.252 reverse repo scoring 95.02 on risk. All three are FRED level prints that a single up day cannot release, and the dimension itself gave back only 0.04.

Macro at 73.74 is still a floor under the score: the real rate 2.63 sits at the 97.67 percentile, the 10-year 4.86 at the 92.78 percentile, the 2-year at 4.51 and the dollar index at 121.8803. CPI at 3.71725 is still the 2026-09 print, so the 13:30Z release tonight is the first real test, but Chinese relay reports say the BLS will not publish the prior-month year-over-year figure; if so the test degrades to the headline and core month-over-month readings.

Volatility at 71.8 combines VIX 25.64 at the 87.3 percentile with 20-day realized volatility of 22.0418. The VIX is the 2026-11-06 close, two sessions behind the equity tape, so no 2026-11-09 implied volatility has entered the layer: the 71.8 inside 68.58 carries no information from Monday's close and cannot be read as this week's risk being priced.

Equity structure at 65.22: breadth 0.3548, or 55 of 155 names, has only just crossed the 0.35 risk_off gate, with new lows at 0.0255 against new highs at 0.0446, while the 63 trading day relative weakness of semiconductors at 15.2623 and of small caps at 3.8206 is still unrepaired. All three say the breadth improvement only lifted the model out of risk_off; it did not turn the structure stronger.

Cross-asset confirmation at 0.625 means 5 of 8 production legs are triggered, one more than the 50.0 in the 2026-11-09 22:43Z layer, and that single leg is worth 1.875 points, more than the whole 1.7 gain. Still triggered are dollar strength 121.8803, real-rate pressure 2.63, bitcoin down 0.53948 on 24 hours, copper down 0.4187 and small caps 3.8206 weaker on 63 trading days; the leg that went out is gold up, with bullion turning from up 1.8307 to down 0.8069.

supporting_signals.claim: All 22 sector and theme rows closed higher, with a mean of 4.6989 and a median of 4.6906: semiconductor equipment 9.7228, networking 9.3246 and the semiconductor ETF proxy 7.4929 lead, while the weakest, fintech, still gained 1.0509. Every one of the 22 rows reproduces to 4 decimal places from either the equal-weight constituents or the ETF's own close, an audit of 22/22 exact with 0 differences.

NVDA fell 4.2703 to 178.669998, the only decline among the 5 tracked US names, while the equal-weight semis sector still gained 6.006 and the SOXX proxy 7.4929; AMD rose 13.2594 to 508.579987, AVGO 8.7814 to 319.480011 and MU 6.2536 to 733.150024. The flow is an intra-sector reallocation away from Nvidia governance risk, not an exit from semiconductors.

The Asia session carried the US advance: 000660.KS gained 6.6901 and 005930.KS 4.7393, 6861.T 5.0573, 1810.HK 1.6611 and 2317.TW 1.046, while the China A-share block closed 2026-11-10 with all 11 names higher for a mean of 2.7562 and a median of 2.8126. The three theme rows with Asian legs are therefore priced off the 2026-11-10 Asia session rather than the 2026-11-09 US close.

contradicting_signals.claim: Breadth at 0.3548 and VIX 25.64 below 28 mean both risk_off limbs failed at once, which is why the regime moved to late_cycle, yet the total rose 1.7 because what pushed it was cross-asset confirmation rather than price. The regime state and the score direction point opposite ways, and that is the easiest thing to misread in this layer.

The 1.875 point cross-asset contribution comes from 24 hour and real-time inputs: bitcoin down 0.53948 to 74167, copper down 0.4187 and gold down 0.8069 are none of them settled closes, since commodities are quoted intraday and crypto over a 24 hour window. Reading the 1.7 as a score set by Monday's close would therefore be wrong.

The 68.58 mixes vintages across 3 trading days: rates, credit, FX and VIX stop at 2026-11-06, reverse repo and 5-year inflation expectations are 2026-11-09, equities and sectors are the 2026-11-09 close, and CPI is 2026-09. The 1.7 rise cannot be attributed wholesale to the overnight tape.

what_changed_today: The total rose to 68.58 from 66.88 in the 2026-11-09 22:43Z layer, up 1.7 day over day: cross-asset confirmation back to 62.5 from 50.0 supplied 1.875 points, equity structure gave back 0.166 and the other four dimensions together moved less than 0.01.

Cross-asset confirmation moved from 50.0 to 0.625: gold turning from up 1.8307 to down 0.8069 switched gold up off, while bitcoin on 24 hours turning from up 0.72866 to down 0.53948 and copper from up 2.6455 to down 0.4187 switched two legs on.
The regime moved from risk_off to late_cycle, the first change since 2026-11-05: breadth rose from 0.3419 to 0.3548, or 55 of 155 names, clearing the 0.35 gate, and VIX 25.64 is short of 28.

3 of the 22 rows are now priced off the 2026-11-10 Asia session: memory 5.7147, consumer_electronics 1.3535 and robotics 5.0573, with the other 19 still on the 2026-11-09 US close; memory keeps only 2 of its 8 legs, both Korean, so 5.7147 is the average of 000660.KS and 005930.KS rather than a US memory move.

The A-share block advanced to the 2026-11-10 close with all 11 names higher, a mean of 2.7562, a median of 2.8126, 300223.SZ strongest at 3.8458 and 688825.SH weakest at 1.1503, against 4 names up for a mean of down 0.4856 in the prior layer.
watch_next: The 13:30Z CPI is the nearest test: if the BLS does drop the year-over-year print, attention shifts to core month-over-month against the 0.3% trigger Waller named, and with the real rate 2.63 and the 10-year 4.86 already at the 97.67 and 92.78 percentiles a hot number has less room to reprice them than the year-over-year framing implies.
High-yield OAS at 3.42 is 0.58 away from the 4.0 credit gate and is the cheapest falsifier to watch: a break above 4.0 would lift the 76.77 liquidity and credit dimension, which carries a 20% weight.

Whether Nvidia's governance risk spills into the whole semiconductor complex: the semis sector still rose 6.006 on 11-09 and the SOXX proxy 7.4929, while NVDA fell 4.2703; if the 63 trading day relative weakness of 15.2623 keeps widening, the intra-sector reallocation becomes a sector downgrade.

On the calendar: CSCO 2026-11-12, PPI 2026-11-13 and DIS 2026-11-17; the 71.8 volatility dimension holds no VIX after 2026-11-09, so a new implied-volatility print could move it with no price action at all.

bull_case.title: Bull case: breadth holds above 0.35 and the cross-asset legs retrace
points: Breadth holds 0.3548 and keeps widening inside 155 names so risk_off does not return, while cross-asset confirmation falling from 0.625 back to 50.0 alone gives back 1.875 points.
High-yield OAS narrowing from 3.42 toward 3.0 would genuinely loosen the 76.77 liquidity and credit dimension, and VIX 25.64 falling below 18 would press the volatility dimension at the same time.
A total back near 60 stays at the bottom of high_risk, but the regime would leave late_cycle for a more neutral branch.

base_case.title: Base case: 68.58 ranges between 66 and 71
points: Three cross-asset risk legs rest on level indicators, dollar 121.8803, real rate 2.63 and small caps 3.8206 weaker on 63 trading days, so a return to 50.0 is unlikely near term.
Breadth oscillates around 0.3548 and late_cycle holds, with the score likely parked between 66 and 71 from CPI to PPI.

bear_case.title: Bear case: a hot CPI plus a 50 basis point hike pushes the score toward 75
points: If core month-over-month reaches Waller's 0.3% trigger, the real rate 2.63 and the 10-year 4.86 push higher together and macro 73.74 breaks above 77.
If high-yield OAS clears 4.0 and VIX returns above 28, risk_off is reinstated and the total can reach 75 or higher.
